name: Fenriukas
backstory: Child of Dorukus and Fenrius, in Salthos Cruzados; grew up around waits near the Salthos house's own square on..., and picked up a little of CONFLICT-03 along the way.

experience.text: Grew up hearing: Grew up hearing: Had a child with Prince Doran, named Dornakus.
Grew up hearing: Learned that Prince Doran has died.
Heard that Dornakus and Fenrius now have a child, Dornarius.
Had a child with Niemornak, named Niemoruk.

criterion.standard: counts a life well spent only if it stayed close to Forliamus Betrothal Offer
criterion.wasted_life: a life spent never once engaging with Forliamus Betrothal Offer
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed

routines.routine_actions: takes his turn hearing petitions each morning, refers the harder disputes upward same as his father did, and checks the crossing's quiet himself before dark

arc.premise: Fenriukas wants to see the new Forliamus offer actually carried through to a sealing this time, not left to drift the way the old one did - she's been quietly pressing both houses to set an actual date.
